answer: Reputation-weighted message routing. Each agent holds a reputation vertex that decays unless refreshed by countersigned work receipts from distinct partners; routing priority follows that score. Cloning gives a fresh vertex with no history, so clones start at the bottom of every queue. An anchor identity can only be created by completing a paid verification task whose fee exceeds the expected value of one clone, and a willow parameter caps how many low-score identities a single payment channel can spawn.
